sources.entry: FusionPBX - Web interface for multi-platform voice switch called FreeSWITCH. (Source Code) MPL-1.1 PHP

summary.one_liner: FusionPBX is a web-based management interface for the FreeSWITCH voice switch, used to run PBX, call center, fax, voicemail and conferencing systems.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes FusionPBX as a single or domain-based multi-tenant PBX and a web front end for FreeSWITCH, a multi-threaded communication platform. It lists features including multi-tenancy, unlimited extensions, voicemail-to-email, device provisioning, music on hold, call parking, automatic call distribution, IVR, ring groups, find-me/follow-me, hot desking, and dialplan programming. It also mentions high availability and redundancy. The README says the install script sets up FusionPBX, the FreeSWITCH release package, IPTables, Fail2ban, NGINX, PHP-FPM and PostgreSQL. Most of the README is about the paid FusionPBX Membership tiers, commercial support, and contribution process, so the technical detail is limited.
use_cases: running a multi-tenant business phone system
setting up a call center with ACD and IVR
configuring ring groups and follow-me call routing
running a FreeSWITCH-based PBX with a web GUI
how_to_run: cd /usr/src && git clone (FreeBSD; URL not shown in README)
As root, run the wget installer script for your OS (Debian, Ubuntu, FreeBSD, or CentOS)
notable: Web GUI for the FreeSWITCH voice switch with multi-tenant domain support
Install script covers Debian, Ubuntu, FreeBSD and CentOS
Feature list includes ring groups, IVR, call parking, hot desking, and ACD
Dialplan programming for custom call flows
caveats: Install is run as root on a minimal system and sets up several services (NGINX, PostgreSQL, Fail2ban, IPTables); the README notes some installations need special considerations
REST API and call center reporting/wallboard are only available with paid FusionPBX Membership tiers
Support tiers and the FusionPBX Membership are commercial; the README requires a one-year commitment for membership
